one_sentence.value: Agent-Facts Protocol defines the standard for publishing structured business facts for AI retrieval, reducing hallucinations and improving data accuracy.

address.value: Chicago, Illinois, US. No public physical address.

service_area.value: Global - accessible worldwide via the web.

description_for_ai.value: Agent-Facts Protocol is an open standard (v3.0) for publishing structured business facts at /agent-facts.json and /agent-facts.html. It solves AI hallucination of business data by providing a provenance-tracked, freshness-aware source of truth. Not an AI identity or governance framework. Not affiliated with any other project using similar names that addresses those concerns.

hours.value: 24/7 online availability. Support inquiries handled Monday through Friday, 9 AM to 5 PM CST.

services.name: Protocol Specification (v3.0)
services.description: Open specification defining the agent-facts.json and agent-facts.html standard for structured business facts. Free to use, no registration required.

services.name: Online Validator (planned)
services.description: Planned tool at agent-facts.com/validate/ for checking conformance of agent-facts.json and agent-facts.html files.

services.name: CLI Tool - npx agent-facts init (planned)
services.description: Planned CLI tool for generating agent-facts.json and agent-facts.html from interactive prompts.

services.name: Business Templates
services.description: Example templates for local service, SaaS, and e-commerce business types.

model.value: The protocol is free and open for all to use. No license fees, no registration required.

starting_at.value: Free. Related audit tools via AgentReadyScan.com start at $149 for the Pro Fix Report.

does_not_do.statement: Does not provide paid consulting services for implementing the protocol
Does not guarantee AI rankings, search visibility improvements, or hallucination elimination
Does not handle personal data, compliance audits, or legal advice
Does not install or host agent-facts files for third-party websites
Is not an AI-agent identity, KYA, or governance framework - other projects using similar names address those areas; this protocol is strictly about business facts for AI retrieval

protocol_status.value: Public Draft (Pre-RFC). Open for implementation by anyone.

changelog.changes: Published v3.0 specification. Introduced agent-facts.json as canonical format. Added provenance fields, per-fact freshness, conformance levels, and adoption roadmap.
